shortDescription: Fetch transport requests from SAP ABAP system based on search criteria

options.name: attributes_keys
options.description: List of attributes keys to read

options.name: category
options.description:
Transport request category
'K' = Workbench
'W' = Customizing
'*' = any category

options.name: client
options.description:
SAP ABAP system client
If not provided, current client (mandant) will be used.

options.name: http_connection
options.description: Dictionary with HTTP(s) connection parameters and configuration to connect to SAP ABAP system

options.name: owner
options.description:
Transport request owner
If not provided, current user will be used.
Use '*' to search for all owners.

options.name: read_attributes
options.description: If true read attributes of transport request

options.name: read_task_headers
options.description: If true read task headers of transport request

options.name: rfc_connection
options.description: Dictionary with RFC connection parameters and configuration to connect to SAP ABAP system

options.name: transport_status
options.description:
Transport request status
'D' = Changeable (including 'L')
'R' = Released (including 'O')
'*' = all statuses (default)
